'''Halavortigas''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Froz]] before its devastation ordered by [[Naomi Dargon]], the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector's]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], for supporting the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Halavortigas was mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a [[2014]] sourcebook published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' module ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.<ref name="SoF" />
